instrument_correction: ETag was the wrong instrument and I nearly shipped its verdict. I compared the two versions' ETags first; they were DIFFERENT on all four keys, and a pre-written reading in the same script called three of them IDENTICAL on the strength of equal byte SIZES. Both halves were wrong. Parquet is not byte-deterministic -- writer metadata, row-group layout and created_by differ between runs -- so an ETag cannot separate 'different code' from 'the same code run twice', and equal size is not equal content. The axis the drift lives on is the SCHEMA, then the VALUES; both are measured above. Recorded because the wrong instrument here would have manufactured a 4-of-4 difference and buried the actual finding, which is that three of the four are identical.
